representative.summary: Scientists have uncovered a surprising difference in how male and female skin repairs and renews itself. This synchronization, driven by sex hormones, helps explain why wounds heal faster in female mice, especially during the first few days.
representative.title: Scientists discover that male and female skin play by different rules
